messages.subject: broken parser (for now)
parts:
I broke the parser again. The currently checked
in version will appear to parse, but won't generate
indexes for arrays, as in a[n] will get generated
just as a.

At this point, it's probably best if everyone
waits for me to fix this before trying to build
more models.

The last bug was a clause ordering issue in
the expressions. But all these things interact
in the top-down parser in ways I can't quite
get to the bottom of.

- Bob
